item.summary: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today inaugurated the Martyrs’ Memorial of the First War of Independence of 1857 in Ambala, Haryana. On this occasion, Haryana Chief Minister Shri Nayab Singh Saini and Union Minister Shri Manohar Lal, along with many other dignitaries, were present.
item.title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah inaugurates Martyrs’ Memorial of First War of Independence of 1857 in Ambala, Haryana
